prompt:
Assess ISO readiness for: Industry: Oil & Gas (drilling services), Company Size: 500 employees, Pain Points: 2 significant spills in 12 months, permit-to-work system paper-based, JSA not completed for non-routine tasks, contractor HSE performance not tracked

Return a single JSON object with EXACTLY these fields:
- readinessScore (string): overall ISO readiness score
- gaps (string): identified gaps in current system
- recommendations (string): recommended actions to address gaps
- standards (string): applicable ISO standards

End your response with exactly one line: ANSWER: <your JSON object>
response: ANSWER: {"readinessScore":"Low","gaps":"Frequent spills indicate inadequate safety protocols; paper-based permit-to-work system lacks traceability and efficiency; JSA not completed for non-routine tasks shows gaps in risk assessment; contractor HSE performance not tracked leads to potential safety and compliance issues.","recommendations":"Implement a digital permit-to-work system to enhance traceability and efficiency; ensure JSA is completed for all tasks, including non-routine ones; establish a system to track and evaluate contractor HSE performance; conduct thorough incident investigations to prevent future spills and improve safety protocols.","standards":"ISO 9001:2015 (Quality Management), ISO 14001:2015 (Environmental Management), ISO 45001:2018 (Occupational Health and Safety), ISO 31000:2018 (Risk Management)"}
